name: agent-trust-card
description: ATC SDK v1.2.0 — issue, verify, and inspect Agent Trust Cards. NEW: ATC/1.4 Unified Verification Profile — verifyLedgerCard() (and verifyATCSync()/verifyATC() auto-dispatch) verify the REAL production ledger envelopes {card_id, status, payload, signature} with real Ed25519 against the embedded CA key registry (rotation-aware, fail-closed on unknown/compromised keys) — previously these cards were only verifiable via the hosted endpoint. Still supports ATC/1.0 (single-sig Ed25519) and ATC v3.0 (multi-format multi-sig: Ed25519/JCS, EAT-CWT/CBOR, W3C VC JSON-LD). Includes CLI (`atc verify card.json` — auto-detects both formats, `atc issue`, `atc inspect`), sync verifyATCSync(), async verifyATC() with optional revocation list fetch. 10 controls (ATC-001..010, 8 required + 2 optional) for ATC/1.0; ATC14-* controls for ledger cards. Ed25519 (RFC 8032) + RFC 8785 JCS. Maintained by AliceLabs LLC (Wyoming, USA, 2026).
author: AliceLabs LLC <info@alicelabs.site>
